source: cashtro/cashtro README, kernel catalog, mission brief, prior desk work

tasks.title: Control plane Phase 0 — bootstrap and access audit
tasks.body: CURRENT_STATE.md, backlog.json, gh access or ACCESS_REQUIRED.md

tasks.title: Control plane Phase 1 — recon every reachable repo
tasks.body: pnpm recon → inventory/repos.json + REPORT.md + GRAPH.md. Idempotent.

tasks.title: Control plane Phase 2 — Prisma registry and SDK
tasks.body: Projects, Capabilities, Agents, Workers, Tasks, Runs, Artifacts, SecretRefs, Events. Seed from inventory + backlog.

tasks.title: Control plane Phase 3 — Fastify API
tasks.body: Projects, agents, tasks, dispatch, pause, runs, metrics, GitHub webhook, OpenAPI /docs.

tasks.title: Register Voltron kernel as the local http runtime
tasks.body: 14 agentics on :8080 become Agents with invokeSpec POST /api/agents/:id/invoke

tasks.title: Bind resident agentics so every seat can execute
tasks.body: operator, reviewer, architect, deploy, security, investigator now execute local verbs. Router stays resident until OpenRouter is bound.

tasks.title: MCP access keys per agent (SecretRef, never the value)
tasks.body: Each agent gets scoped MCP SecretRefs. Values resolve at runtime from env/vault.

tasks.title: Unblock Evolu-Jeunes recon with Option A PAT
tasks.body: See docs/ACCESS_REQUIRED.md. 48 claimed private repos are invisible.

tasks.body: WordPress. Live client. Do not touch production.

tasks.body: WordPress. Live client. Do not touch production.

tasks.title: ScanApp — lock concept verbs (scan / CRM / bots)
tasks.body: Concept contract is docs/SCANAPP.md. Three capabilities: scan.ingest, crm.upsert, bot.reply. Not a live client.

tasks.title: ScanApp — draft agent.manifest.json handshake
tasks.body: Draft lives at inventory/drafts/scanapp/agent.manifest.json. Open a PR against the real repo after recon finds it.

tasks.title: ScanApp — find the real GitHub repo
tasks.body: Blocked on Evolu-Jeunes PAT. Do not guess Evolu-Jeunes/scanapp. After access: pnpm recon, attach repoUrl.

tasks.title: ScanApp — onboard the real repo into the network
tasks.body: TypeScript + Python. Concept product. Attach repo, merge handshake, do not treat as production.

tasks.title: Keep OpenRouter optional to boot
tasks.body: Kernel boots without a key. Control plane must too.
